# Questions

### Q-1 · Do tabs count as pages
Blocks: G-design · Default: B · Door: 2-way · Owner: product · Answer-by: 2026-10-12
Context: Some pages have tabs. We need to know if opening a tab counts as a page view.
A. Count pages only: fewer rows, but tab use stays hidden.
B. Count pages and tabs: more rows, and admins see tab use. We recommend B because admins asked for it.
If no answer by 2026-10-12, we build B.
